# sdwan_service_appqoe_feature (Data Source)

This data source can read the Service AppQoE Feature.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sdwan_service_appqoe_feature" "example" {
  id                 = "f6b2c44c-693c-4763-b010-895aa3d236bd"
  feature_profile_id = "f6dd22c8-0b4f-496c-9a0b-6813d1f8b8ac"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `feature_profile_id` (String) Feature Profile ID

### Optional

- `id` (String) The id of the Feature
- `name` (String) The name of the Feature

### Read-Only

- `appqoe_device_role` (String) Appqoe Device Role
- `combined_controller_groups` (Attributes List) Appnav controller group name (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--combined_controller_groups))
- `combined_service_contexts` (Attributes List) Appqoe (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--combined_service_contexts))
- `combined_service_node_groups` (Attributes List) Name (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--combined_service_node_groups))
- `description` (String) The description of the Feature
- `forwarder_controller_groups` (Attributes List) Appnav controller group name (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--forwarder_controller_groups))
- `forwarder_service_contexts` (Attributes List) Appqoe (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--forwarder_service_contexts))
- `forwarder_service_node_groups` (Attributes List) Name (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--forwarder_service_node_groups))
- `service_node_service_node_groups` (Attributes List) Name (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service_node_service_node_groups))
- `version` (Number) The version of the Feature
- `virtual_applications` (Attributes List) Virtual application Instance (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--virtual_applications))
